digest.component_or_area: MCP server infrastructure / AWS credential provisioning
propositions: MCP bridge tools fail immediately with missing credentials error because JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN, and JIRA_PROJECT environment variables are not wired to the container
Three Jira credentials were seeded out-of-band into AWS SSM as operator-managed parameters but have no corresponding Terraform declarations, causing ParameterAlreadyExists collision on next apply

JIRA_PROJECT environment variable is required by probe scope resolution but is read from environment only, not from rebar.toml config, so wiring three credentials alone moves failure from missing_credentials to missing_project
Fetch-secrets script must read credentials optionally without aborting, since absent outbound integration credentials should degrade gracefully rather than block entire MCP deployment
Terraform user_data.sh contains unescaped brace expansions in HCL comments that cause templatefile parsing failures, blocking all terraform planning
